latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Maker Best.
- Upload and combine video clips into polished 1080p MP4s without manual editing.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Fast, cloud-based GPU processing returns finished videos in 1–2 minutes.
- No installation required; works via API using free or personal tokens.
- Features timeline editing, workflow guidance, error handling, and export to MP4.
